title: ALIX bin/wt makes .worktree/ but relay expects .worktrees
what: relay reads a project's worktree folder from its kit.toml [project] worktrees (or what its bin/wt creates) instead of assuming .worktrees, so ALIX's .worktree/ worktrees are recognised; nothing is changed in ALIX by this item.
why: 26 Oct, found by the portable-tool design (scratchpad reports/design-portable.md): ALIX's bin/wt creates .worktree/ (singular) while the guard hook expects .worktrees. Not yet reproduced. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A temporary project whose bin/wt makes .worktree/<task>: relay's guard treats a session in .worktree/x as the main checkout (or refuses its work).
pass_cases: The same session is treated as a task worktree; a project using .worktrees is unchanged.
where: plugins/relay/hooks/guard-main.sh relay's guard hooks (the worktree folder they expect)

fact: Migration 27 Oct: the link in `why` line 1 points to a session file (`reports/design-portable.md` of 26 Oct, in the session session folder; a copy is in relay's backup folder), which is deleted when the machine restarts; the facts it held that this item rests on are the notes below.

Could not recover: the claim that ALIX's `bin/wt` creates `.worktree/` (singular) while relay's guard hook expects `.worktrees` is not in the saved text of `design-portable.md` (a search of the file for `.worktree` without the s found nothing; its only worktree-tool line is about how git.md names a project's tool). The item itself says it was not reproduced.
Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)

Reproduced 29 Oct: /Users/amidman/alix/bin/wt line 5 creates .worktree/<name>; ALIX has no .claude/kit.toml. relay's guard finds the session's checkout through git (plugins/relay/hooks/guard_main.py:214-218), but its write check defaults the worktree folder to .worktrees (:202, :231) and exempts only that folder (:256-258), so writes in .worktree/x are refused (:290). Session-start detection is not affected.
